title: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Nene Yashiro summons the school ghost Hanako-san hoping for romance and finds a boy spirit who binds her as his assistant. Together they handle the supernatural beings born from school rumors, while Hanako's past, including his twin brother's death, slowly comes to light.
life_message: A life of patient kindness, facing loneliness and the past honestly, and helping others even when it costs something.
